races.name: Highclere Castle Gin Summer Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
SING US A SONG has taken his form up a notch this season, running well when fifth in the Copper Horse at Royal Ascot, and he could be ready to resume winning ways with more still to offer over this distance. Heading the list of dangers is Hopewell Rock, who is worth another chance to build on his Newmarket reappearance effort, ahead of Valedictory.

  1. SING US A SONG (IRE)
  2. HOPEWELL ROCK (IRE)
  3. VALEDICTORY

races.name: Coral Glorious Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict:
IN MY TEENS blew a competitive Curragh handicap apart 5 weeks ago and should be well up to making her presence felt at this level with a repeat. She gets the vote over the William Haggas pair Al Aasy, who is seeking a hat-trick in this race, and the up-and-coming Opportunity, who won the Duke of Edinburgh in good style.

  1. IN MY TEENS (IRE)
  2. AL AASY (IRE)
  3. OPPORTUNITY

races.name: Qatar Lillie Langtry Stakes (Fillies & Mares' Group 2)
races.verdict:
WAARDAH can repeat last year's success in this having shaped well behind subsequent Group 1 winner Estrange in the Pinnacle Stakes at Carlisle on her return. Danielle pushed the selection close in this 12 months ago and may emerge as the chief threat again, though Consent escapes a penalty for her Group 1 win at Longchamp and is likely to bounce back from her underwhelming reappearance.

  1. WAARDAH (IRE)
  2. DANIELLE
  3. CONSENT (IRE)

races.name: Coral Stewards' Cup (Heritage Handicap)
races.verdict:
FAR ABOVE DREAM has a fine Goodwood record and James Owen's gelding can build on his promising Wokingham fourth to land this major handicap. Several others merit strong consideration, including the progressive Tuco Salamanca, the potentially well-handcapped Annaf, Curragh 1-2 Sondad and Dark Thirty, and top-weight Soldier's Tree.

  1. FAR ABOVE DREAM (IRE)
  2. TUCO SALAMANCA (IRE)
  3. ANNAF (IRE)

races.name: Phase Eight Handicap
races.verdict:
WE'RE GOOSERS clearly didn't do himself justice in the Britannia at Royal Ascot in June but he'd previously been mightily impressive when routing the opposition at Newmarket on his penultimate start in May. Gelded ahead of this and still appealing as being on a good mark, he's fancied to make a bold bid to bounce back from a handy draw. Low-mileage and progressive Marengo Storm is another to consider, with Ghost Mode and Egoli also respected.

  1. WE'RE GOOSERS (IRE)
  2. MARENGO STORM
  3. GHOST MODE (IRE)

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Stakes (Colts & Geldings)
races.verdict:
AL WATHBA's promising debut second was well advertised here earlier in the week, and he's fancied to land this valuable maiden. There's surely a bigger performance to come from Speakers Corner, provided he can overcome the widest stall, while the Wathnan Racing pair Chartered Course and Market Leader also make plenty of appeal in a field stacked with interesting types.

  1. AL WATHBA (FR)
  2. SPEAKERS CORNER (IRE)
  3. CHARTED COURSE

races.name: Coral Rewards Shaker Handicap
races.verdict:
Although BLUE COURVOISIER has gained both his wins on stiff tracks his enthusiastic style should lend itself even better to a speed-favouring course such as this one and he gets the vote from a handy stall. Fellow 3-y-o Crest of Fire hasn't fared quite so well with the draw but is still feared most ahead of Spell Master and Thunder Wonder.

  1. BLUE COURVOISIER
  2. CREST OF FIRE (IRE)
  3. SPELL MASTER

races.name: BOYLE Sports Best Odds Guaranteed Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
COLUMBUS shaped well on hurdling/stable debut when runner-up at Killarney in May and is taken to leave behind a lesser effort at Royal Ascot back in this sphere. He gets the vote ahead of Young Rebel, who has changed hands since his impressive bumper victory in November, with Tiktok Casey another to consider.

  1. COLUMBUS (GER)
  2. YOUNG REBEL (IRE)
  3. TIKTOK CASEY (IRE)

races.name: BOYLE Sports Galway Tribes Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
PAUL'S DREAM is firmly on the up and is taken to defy her latest rise to complete the hat-trick. Fiveonefive is on a handy mark and was unlucky not to finish closer at Ballinrobe last time, so rates the chief threat, with the unexposed Lips Freedom, last year’s winner Come On The Lads and this week's Galway Hurdle hero Putapoundinthejar on the shortlist.

  1. PAUL'S DREAM (IRE)
  2. FIVEONEFIVE (IRE)
  3. LIPS FREEDOM (GER)

races.name: BOYLE Sports Handicap Hurdle (Listed)
races.verdict:
COMFORT ZONE returned to form with a bang when landing a Flat handicap at this course just 5 days ago and is likely to prove hard to beat if carrying that form back over hurdles. Minella Diamond arrives on an upward curve and is feared most, while Ifiwerearichman and Double Powerful are also capable of getting involved if at their best.

  1. COMFORT ZONE (IRE)
  2. MINELLA DIAMOND (IRE)
  3. IFIWEREARICHMAN (IRE)
  4. DOUBLE POWERFUL (IRE)

races.name: Electric Galway Irish EBF Mares Flat Race
races.verdict:
FLEUR DINO makes plenty of appeal on pedigree and may continue Willie Mullins' recent domination of this race. Glens Sonata looks no slouch on paper, either, and she could make it a 1-2 for the yard. Tamara Jane looks the pick of those with experience under Rules, with Techno DJ an interesting type from the pointing scene.

  1. FLEUR DINO (IRE)
  2. GLENS SONATA (IRE)
  3. TAMARA JANE (IRE)

races.name: Whiriskey Refrigeration Irish EBF Maiden
races.verdict:
VICTORY SPEECH has strong claims to go one better than on debut. Zarak Pasha looks sure to make a race of it.

  1. VICTORY SPEECH (IRE)
  2. ZARAK PASHA (IRE)
  3. THOMAS CHIPPENDALE (IRE)

races.name: Bathshack Maiden
races.verdict:
GLIONDAR shaped really well on his debut at the Curragh in June and looks sure to improve. He can open his account. Royal Bones and Bang Bang may give him most to think about.

  1. GLIONDAR (FR)
  2. ROYAL BONES (IRE)
  3. BANG BANG (IRE)

races.name: Ardilaun Hotel Handicap
races.verdict:
He comes with a health warning after 23 defeats but APACHE OUTLAW is worth another chance given how well he's been shaping of late. He also went close at this meeting last year and tackles an easier 0-70 now. San Aer was second here on Tuesday and can go well again, while British raider The Sweet Escape and Mytimetoshine are also considered.

  1. APACHE OUTLAW (IRE)
  2. SAN AER (IRE)
  3. THE SWEET ESCAPE

races.name: McDonogh Capital Investments Handicap
races.verdict:
Having been gambled on FRATAS stepped up on her recent stable debut when runner up in a big-field handicap hurdle here 3 days ago, looking unfortunate to bump into such a progressive rival. She's gone well here in the past and could be worth siding with from a reduced mark back in this sphere. Granville Street is another boasting good course form and is feared along with last year's winner Thatwilldoso. Superficial is another in with a shout.

  1. FRATAS (IRE)
  2. GRANVILLE STREET (IRE)
  3. THATWILLDOSO (IRE)

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Chalice Stakes (Fillies' & Mares' Listed) (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Three-year-olds have won 6 of the last 7 runnings so it's perhaps best to focus on the younger generation. ROMANTIC SYMPHONY got her career firmly back on track after her blip in the Lingfield Oaks Trial when second in a French listed race and is preferred to improving duo Gone By and Sunshine Star.

  1. ROMANTIC SYMPHONY (IRE)
  2. GONE BY (IRE)
  3. SUNSHINE STAR

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Nursery
races.verdict:
ROLLTHEDICEBABY is taken to resume her progression back at 6f and deny Glamorize a hat-trick. Love A Giggle and Acclamation Star should find this a bit less demanding than the Group races they've been contesting and are also likely to be very competitive.

  1. ROLLTHEDICEBABY (IRE)
  2. GLAMORIZE (IRE)
  3. LOVE A GIGGLE (IRE)

races.name: Lodge At The National Stud EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This will probably go to a newcomer. SPIRITED GESTURE is bred to be smart and is preferred to Haleema and Asheyra before any betting clues are known.

  1. SPIRITED GESTURE
  2. HALEEMA
  3. ASHEYRA (IRE)

races.name: Racing TV Handicap
races.verdict:
SIERRA SANDS and Lion of Mali fought out the finish of a C&D handicap at the July meeting here. Three subsequent winners have already emerged from that race so small nudges from the handicapper may not prevent them dominating again.

  1. SIERRA SANDS (IRE)
  2. LION OF MALI
  3. HARDY'S HERO

races.name: Racing Welfare Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
DIVINE KNIGHT appeals as one who'll be winning for his top stable soon and is preferred to First Officer, who ran a cracker up against a 3-y-o here last time.

  1. DIVINE KNIGHT (IRE)
  2. FIRST OFFICER (IRE)
  3. ARQOOB (IRE)

races.name: National Stud Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
The front-running FOOD FOR THOUGHT may be able to dominate this small-field race. Thaluna has held her own in some competitive handicaps and may give Ralph Beckett's charge most to do.

  1. FOOD FOR THOUGHT
  2. THALUNA
  3. VALKYRIE STORM

races.name: British Racing School Handicap
races.verdict:
SILKY ROBIN is taken to complete a hat-trick for the second year running and deny Dottie Diamond a 4-timer.

  1. SILKY ROBIN (IRE)
  2. DOTTIE DIAMOND
  3. MERRIMACK

races.name: Professional Horse Racing Tips At chracingclub.com Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
BINTKNIGHT opened her account over this C&D in May and progressed further when second at Doncaster 29 days ago, so makes plenty of appeal back at the scene of that breakthrough. Londoner remains in good form and was unlucky when trapped on the rail at Sandown 9 days ago, while Percival took a step forward last time and looks on a competitive mark.

  1. BINTKNIGHT
  2. LONDONER (IRE)
  3. PERCIVAL (FR)

races.name: Happy 50th Birthday Joanne Baker Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
The fact ZAFAAN has won a race counts for plenty in this grade and he's taken to give the weight away, with Private Project getting the nod for the forecast spot.

  1. ZAFAAN (IRE)
  2. PRIVATE PROJECT (IRE)
  3. LAPIDARIST

races.name: Pilgrims Sales & Lettings Handicap
races.verdict:
CAMPEONA looked more focused in first-time cheekpieces when completing a Newbury double 9 days ago and looks capable of defying a 4 lb higher mark. Laravie should be suited by the return to 2m and is feared most, while An Bradan Feasa is respected back on the Flat having been second over this C&D in June.

  1. CAMPEONA
  2. LARAVIE (IRE)
  3. AN BRADAN FEASA (IRE)

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ROGUE EXILE made a promising start at Yarmouth a fortnight ago, looking better as the race wore on, and makes plenty of appeal in a thin maiden with improvement on the way. The returning Justice Court is the clear danger.

  1. ROGUE EXILE (IRE)
  2. JUSTICE COURT (IRE)
  3. MALAKAI KITE (IRE)

races.name: Drainex Group Nursery
races.verdict:
LAYLATY could only run to a similar level as on debut when third in a Newbury novice 23 days ago, yet her first run did contain abundant promise and she's well worth another chance to get back on the up making a quick switch to nurseries. This is competitive, though, with last-time-out winners Knock Three Times and Miss Moneypit heading up the dangers.

  1. LAYLATY
  2. KNOCK THREE TIMES (IRE)
  3. MISS MONEYPIT

races.name: Core Group Handicap
races.verdict:
MUSICAL SOLDIER found some improvement for the fitting of first-time cheekpieces when doubling his tally at Wolverhampton 11 days ago and he looks to hold sound claims of following up from a 5 lb higher mark back on turf. The danger could be fellow 3-y-o Creciente, who was a convincing winner of a C&D classified event 10 days ago and can hold her own back in a handicap.

  1. MUSICAL SOLDIER (IRE)
  2. CRECIENTE
  3. JACKSON STREET (IRE)

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
ALLEGRINO found a little more improvement when doubling her career tally at Yarmouth and she could well take some pegging back under another positive ride from a 3 lb higher mark. Distinct Spirit has returned from an absence in excellent order, successful himself at Ffos Las 4 days ago, and rates a major threat under a penalty.

  1. ALLEGRINO (IRE)
  2. DISTINCT SPIRIT
  3. WETSAND (IRE)

races.name: Scullion Law 'Law Firm For Life' EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CALIFORNIA SCHOOL didn't really get going until it was too late in what was probably a warm novice at Newbury and he can find the required improvement to beat Henley On Thames.

  1. CALIFORNIA SCHOOL (IRE)
  2. HENLEY ON THAMES (IRE)
  3. BEARING GIFTS (IRE)

races.name: Strathmore Hotels Ltd Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
KISSMEHONEYHONEY wasn't seen to best effect in a listed contest on just her second start in May and remains with plenty of potential. The only winner in the field, she can get back on track down in grade. Tiernan and According To Mark can surely find races and the trio aren't easy to split in what looks a competitive novice despite the numbers.

  1. KISSMEHONEYHONEY
  2. TIERNAN (IRE)
  3. ACCORDING TO MARK (IRE)

races.name: PDM Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
There's a good chance COTTON BUD can resume progress stepping up in trip and she's preferred to fellow 3-y-o Dunkeld Dreamer, who was unsuited by the muddling pace over C&D 3 weeks ago. Low-mileage 7-y-o Gallus Norman has progressed switched to handicaps this year and is another to consider if turned out again.

  1. COTTON BUD (IRE)
  2. DUNKELD DREAMER (IRE)
  3. GALLUS NORMAN

races.name: Cube Glass 'Soba' Handicap
races.verdict:
COROLLA POINT has been shaping up well and is taken to resume winning ways. His stablemate Fluorescence has shown enough in listed/Group races on her last 2 outings to think a mark of 90 is workable and she's second choice ahead of Jordan Electrics and Manila Scouse.

  1. COROLLA POINT (IRE)
  2. FLUORESCENCE
  3. JORDAN ELECTRICS

races.name: Blitz Cleaning Commercial Cleaning Handicap
races.verdict:
HUNDRED CAPS often keeps better company so is taken to defy top weight. The thriving Little Mi Mi and course specialist Iris Dancer head the dangers.

  1. HUNDRED CAPS
  2. LITTLE MI MI (IRE)
  3. IRIS DANCER

races.name: GSS Contracts Handicap
races.verdict:
MWAFAQ continues to thrive and should make a bold bid for the hat-trick. Rajapour and Starliner are others to consider.

  1. MWAFAQ (IRE)
  2. RAJAPOUR (IRE)
  3. STARLINER (IRE)

races.name: Wellman Cars Hamilton Handicap
races.verdict:
PISANELLO escapes a penalty for his recent win at Redcar so can complete a quickfire hat-trick if this doesn't come too soon. Braes of Doune is next best ahead of Defence Missile.

  1. PISANELLO (IRE)
  2. BRAES OF DOUNE
  3. DEFENCE MISSILE (IRE)

races.name: John & Paula 25th Wedding Anniversary EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BATTLE FEVER receives a handy 7 lb from Palm Reader and that could be enough to reverse last month's Beverley form. Newcomer Red Blue Point is one to note for support.

  1. BATTLE FEVER (IRE)
  2. PALM READER (IRE)
  3. RED BLUE POINT (IRE)

races.name: William Hill Summer Cup Handicap
races.verdict:
MIRSKY is back on the same mark as when successful in the Thirsk Hunt Cup in May and could be the one to be with reunited with Danny Tudhope. Northern Express has solid claims to follow up his recent York win, with Mr Swivell and Jeddaal others to consider.

  1. MIRSKY
  2. NORTHERN EXPRESS (IRE)
  3. MR SWIVELL

races.name: Theakston Great Yorkshire Pint EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BRIGHTON BEACH's Chester form was given a timely boost earlier this week and she may get off the mark with Danny Tudhope taking over. Regal Desire is feared in her bid to make it third time lucky, while there should be better to come from Le Samourai.

  1. BRIGHTON BEACH (IRE)
  2. REGAL DESIRE (FR)
  3. LE SAMOURAI (IRE)

races.name: Jordan Foy Memorial Handicap
races.verdict:
Preference is for ROTOKURA BELLE, who got back on track at York last time and can race off the same mark here. Rock of England and Canaria Queen are also of interest.

  1. ROTOKURA BELLE
  2. ROCK OF ENGLAND (IRE)
  3. CANARIA QUEEN

races.name: William Hill Epic Boosts Handicap
races.verdict:
There should be plenty more to come from ASUKA, who starts his handicapping career off a fair mark. He looks the one to beat. Angel Hunter and Yorkshire head the list of dangers.

  1. ASUKA
  2. ANGEL HUNTER
  3. YORKSHIRE (IRE)

races.name: Vision PVC Carlton Miniott Thirsk Handicap
races.verdict:
After a couple of near misses, LA PEREGRINA should be able to get off the mark. Ludo's Landing looks the pace angle and most likely danger.

  1. LA PEREGRINA
  2. LUDO'S LANDING (IRE)
  3. THAT DARN CANTOR

races.name: John Joseph Robson Memorial Handicap
races.verdict:
GREAT didn't get the breaks at Beverley last time and will be suited by the return to this longer trip. He makes plenty of appeal. Kings Merchant and Mecca's Symphony can also make their presence felt.

  1. GREAT
  2. KINGS MERCHANT
  3. MECCA'S SYMPHONY

races.name: Aalberts IPS Pegler Valves Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BRASH looks the percentage call in a weak race. Unexposed Kohana Nation is by far the most interesting of the remainder.

  1. BRASH (IRE)
  2. KOHANA NATION (IRE)
  3. TRIPLE P

races.name: BAPP Group Of Companies BAPP Nursery
races.verdict:
An extremely trappy nursery. WELEYFF found plenty once rolling at Ayr last time and may be able to repeat the feat on the long home straight here. Eighth Immortal is feared stepping back up to 7f, along with likely improver Prince Kameo.

  1. WELEYFF (IRE)
  2. EIGHTH IMMORTAL (IRE)
  3. PRINCE KAMEO

races.name: 7 Core Electrical Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
TIORA TIME made an encouraging start at Epsom 3 weeks ago and gets the vote with that experience likely to have brought her on a good deal. There are surely races in Forest Berry if she can settle down, while Romotoso and Pon Pon Dalia are appealing newcomers.

  1. TIORA TIME
  2. FOREST BERRY
  3. ROMOTOSO

races.name: Yates Drywall Ltd Handicap
races.verdict:
MARINER has returned to form on his last 2 starts, nearest at the finish when fourth at this course on his latest outing, and he could be ready to take advantage of his reduced mark. Super Hit is feared most having been rejuvenated by James Owen, ahead of Whiskey Pete who has dropped a long way in the weights.

  1. MARINER (IRE)
  2. SUPER HIT (FR)
  3. WHISKEY PETE (IRE)

races.name: Winners Wear Skopes Menswear Handicap
races.verdict:
FIRST TIME looks the most solid option in a rather trappy event. Vidmiyr had been in good form prior to York and can bounce back, whilst Haaderr perhaps worth another chance after a disappointing handicap debut.

  1. FIRST TIME (IRE)
  2. VIDMIYR (IRE)
  3. HAADERR

races.name: Harrison College Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
GET UP EVERYBODY can build on the promise of his Ripon success and shed his maiden tag. Moonhall Lass was a bit disappointing at Leicester last time but remains of interest on the strength of her win there on her penultimate start. Sparkling Pink completes the shortlist.

  1. GET UP EVERYBODY (IRE)
  2. MOONHALL LASS (IRE)
  3. SPARKLING PINK

races.name: Harrison College Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
A weak race which can go the way of VON TROTTER, who has shown a bit of promise on his last 2 outings having tumbled in the weights. Donald hasn't offered much this season but drops in grade and his best form would give him a serious shout, with Wilde And Dandy taken to complete the 1-2-3.

  1. VON TROTTER
  2. DONALD
  3. WILDE AND DANDY

races.name: Grace And Dotty Handicap
races.verdict:
Having dropped to a handy mark, ANOTHER INVESTMENT has finished runner-up on his last 2 starts and he is taken to get back to winning ways this time around. The main danger could be the unexposed Celtic Arrow, with Startled Lady also a contender after getting off the mark on her latest outing.

  1. ANOTHER INVESTMENT (IRE)
  2. CELTIC ARROW (FR)
  3. STARTLED LADY
